lines.text: At Horeb the LORD said Israel had stayed long enough and told them to enter the land.
Moses said he could not carry the burden alone, because the LORD had scattered the people across the desert.

wrong_details.wrong: scattered the people across the desert
wrong_details.true: made them as numerous as the stars

lines.text: Joshua told the people to choose wise men from each tribe and appointed them over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.
